objective: Surface verification_email_sent=false on check-email after public signup; keep resend on the same email and tenant. Ops FRONTEND_BASE_URL naming lives in the API repo contract of the same id.
non_goals: Do not prove real SES / outside-inbox delivery
Do not touch paid plans, one-email-one-org, or verify-before-invite beyond existing main

invariants: Web signup still posts org+admin to POST /tenants/signup
No JSX in frozen apps/idp-web or packages/ui

notes: Paired with API lot1-funnel-polish. Assumed sent=0|1 query flag. Pre-mortem: silent success when mail failed.

risk.rationale: Public signup funnel honesty for unverified admin email delivery.

acceptance.criterion: Signup with verification_email_sent=false redirects with sent=0; check-email load sets verificationEmailSent false; resend keeps email+tenant.
Successful signup still redirects to check-email with email and tenant.

tasks.outcome: Wire sent flag and honest UI; harden resend tenant; run signup and check-email unit tests.
